The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Nextbridge Ltd. is **Muhammad Ishaq**. He is described as a seasoned technology executive with extensive experience in leading engineering and technology strategy, spanning over two decades in the industry. His profile highlights his role in shaping Nextbridge's technological direction, including expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud computing, and engineering leadership [Document 1, p.0]. 

Faizan Chughtai is listed as a former Senior Software Engineer at Nextbridge Ltd. (2012–2015) but does not hold the CTO title in the provided context [Document 2].
